gen-gf-faustina-fs-epilogue: Epilogue brings curvy, unclamped letters with a wire-thin skeleton and stubby ascenders. Epilogue sits easily under Faustina, whose calligraphic nib gives the headline a classic, authoritative tone above that plain sans.
gen-gf-faustina-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans looks like bent tubing, with s curves that open wide and a generous x-height. Faustina, meanwhile, thins like letters stamped in soft metal, and that gives headings their weight while the body stays clean.
gen-gf-faustina-fs-public-sans: Sturdy and wide-mouthed, this pairing leads with Faustina, whose thin strokes are only slightly lighter than its thick ones. And Public Sans backs it with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters that hold the text steady.
gen-gf-faustina-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and dense, a heavy-looking band of text whose letters seem held open rather than curled shut. Supreme also pairs with Faustina's gently lightening curves, and a modest body size would let that sturdy texture breathe.
gen-gf-faustina-manrope: Manrope reads bright and clean, with a wide gap at every curve and hardly any step from capital to lowercase. Pages of it would flow smoothly beside Faustina's measured, restrained stroke rhythm.
gen-gf-faustina-montserrat: Faustina carries a classic, authoritative voice, its strokes tapering gently where they bend, against the geometric glide of Montserrat. Faustina earns its place at large sizes with short lines.
gen-gf-faustina-satoshi: Tall, open and rope-fine, Satoshi sets the tone below. Faustina's calm modulation never snags the eye, so its classic authority and the soaring lowercase of Satoshi sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-faustina-switzer: Swiss precision meets old-world nib work here. Faustina is best at lending classic authority with horizontals that stay lighter yet never threadlike, while Switzer keeps its tubular, wire-like letters uniform and tidy.
gen-gf-fira-code-manrope: Precise and structured, Fira Code spaces every letter generously like a typewriter would. Its strongest quality is the contrast with Manrope, whose smooth single-width line and bright open curves feel entirely approachable.
gen-gf-fira-code-satoshi: Typewriter-like, evenly spaced letters mark Fira Code as unmistakable. It does structure best, giving a precise, tall-lowercase frame, while Satoshi's soaring x-height and hairline-free strokes handle the approachable running text.
